aiVerification.summary: Draft is comparable but needs correction because changed-factor wording and several outcome groupings are ambiguous or contaminated.
issues: Primary factor should be C-MG color-difference material/lot condition, not generic process condition.
Type 1-3 versus Level 1-3 mapping is not proven in cited rows.
Tension measurement outcome incorrectly includes function rows with zero stats.
Function/check rows are split into an invalid measurement-only outcome.
Several outcomes lack nearby header/context citations needed to interpret columns.
requiredUserQuestions: Do Level 1, Level 2, and Level 3 correspond to the three C-MG color-difference test types?
Is Normal the intended baseline for all result sections?
correctionPlan: Rename changed factor to Normal C-MG versus color-difference C-MG test levels/types from vendor Baotou.
Keep Baotou as supplier/subgroup context unless source proves it is the changed factor.
Remove function rows from the tension measurement outcome.
Merge function defect rows under the check-function outcome and delete the invalid measurement-2 outcome.
Cite section headers plus each compared data row for every outcome.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but grouping citations are insufficient until corrected.
